name: federalregister
description: Federal Register (federalregister.gov): search and read U.S. federal rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents, agencies, public inspection filings and topic searches through the official public JSON API.

commands.name: search-documents
commands.summary: Search published Federal Register documents by keyword, with optional filters for type, agency, publication date and significance, plus sort and paging

params.name: term
params.description: Full-text search query. Supports quoted phrases and | for OR.

params.name: type
params.description: Document type code: RULE=Rule, PRORULE=Proposed Rule, NOTICE=Notice, PRESDOCU=Presidential Document

params.name: agency
params.description: Agency slug, e.g. environmental-protection-agency. Get slugs from list-agencies.

params.name: published_since
params.description: Only documents published on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: published_before
params.description: Only documents published on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: significant
params.description: 1 = only documents deemed significant under EO 12866; 0 = only non-significant documents

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page (default 20, max 1000)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1

commands.name: get-document
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one Federal Register document by its document number: abstract, action, dates, CFR references, dockets and full-text links

params.name: document_number
params.description: Federal Register document number, e.g. 2026-11091

commands.name: get-documents
commands.summary: Get metadata for several Federal Register documents at once, given a comma-separated list of document numbers

params.name: document_numbers
params.description: Comma-separated document numbers, e.g. 2026-05314,2025-20213

commands.name: count-documents-by-facet
commands.summary: Count documents matching a search, grouped by agency, document type, topic, section or publication period (facet counts)

params.name: facet
params.description: Field to group counts by

params.name: term
params.description: Full-text search query

params.name: type
params.description: Document type code to restrict counts to

params.name: agency
params.description: Agency slug to restrict counts to

params.name: published_since
params.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) lower bound on publication date

params.name: published_before
params.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) upper bound on publication date

commands.name: export-documents-csv
commands.summary: Export documents matching a search as CSV text (document number, title, type, date, agencies, citation, URLs)

params.name: term
params.description: Full-text search query

params.name: type
params.description: Document type code

params.name: agency
params.description: Agency slug

params.name: published_since
params.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) lower bound on publication date

params.name: published_before
params.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) upper bound on publication date

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order

params.name: per_page
params.description: Rows per page (max 1000)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number

commands.name: list-agencies
commands.summary: List all Federal Register agencies with id, slug, short name, parent and child agencies

commands.name: get-agency
commands.summary: Get one agency's details (description, short name, logo, parent/child agencies, recent-documents link) by slug or numeric id

params.name: slug
params.description: Agency slug (e.g. securities-and-exchange-commission) or numeric agency id

commands.name: list-current-public-inspection
commands.summary: List documents currently on public inspection, which are filed but not yet published in the Federal Register

commands.name: list-public-inspection-by-date
commands.summary: List the documents that were on public inspection on a given date

params.name: date
params.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the documents were available for inspection

commands.name: get-public-inspection-document
commands.summary: Get one public inspection document by document number: filing time, scheduled publication date, PDF and raw-text links

params.name: document_number
params.description: Document number, e.g. 2026-21259

commands.name: list-suggested-searches
commands.summary: List curated topic searches (e.g. Dodd-Frank, stock trading), grouped by section, with saved search conditions and recent document counts

commands.name: get-suggested-search
commands.summary: Get one curated topic search by slug, including its description and the search conditions to reuse with search-documents

params.name: slug
params.description: Suggested search slug from list-suggested-searches

commands.name: get-image
commands.summary: Get metadata and download URLs (large, medium, original size) for an image embedded in a Federal Register document

params.name: identifier
params.description: Image identifier from a document's 'images' map, e.g. EP03JN26.006

notes: The HTML website is behind a CAPTCHA. All commands use the public, unauthenticated JSON API under /api/v1, which needs no login or key.
Document type codes: RULE (Rule), PRORULE (Proposed Rule), NOTICE (Notice), PRESDOCU (Presidential Document). Agency filters take slugs from list-agencies, e.g. environmental-protection-agency.
Search results are capped: 'count' tops out at 10000 and only a limited number of pages can be retrieved. Narrow results with filters or date ranges instead of paging deep.
count-documents-by-facet returns an object keyed by facet value (agency slug, type code, etc.), each with {count, name}.
list-suggested-searches returns an object keyed by section (e.g. 'money'). Each topic's search_conditions.term can be passed to search-documents --term.
Public inspection documents are filed but not yet published. Their publication_date is the scheduled date and may be null for special filings. Check editorial_note for withdrawals.
export-documents-csv returns raw CSV text. Use per_page (max 1000) and page to get larger exports.
